panels.prompt: Create ONE full-bleed landscape comic panel, 3:2 aspect ratio, high resolution. Inked graphic novel / European paper comic style. Confident hand-inked dark navy outlines, colored pencil and screenprinted halftone texture on warm ivory paper. Max and Boris sit on neighboring wooden bar stools at Tony's beach bar, playing cards directly on the wooden counter and idly drinking Garret Non-Alcoholic. Max props his chin on his hand, looking sluggishly bored. Boris distractedly examines his cards with lowered shoulders; the card deal has stalled. On the counter between them are two identical glass handled beer mugs with pale golden drink and visible recognizable bottles of Garret Non-Alcoholic. Max: adult athletic man ~28, curly brown hair, facial stubble, white tank top, dark green shorts with yellow flowers. Boris: adult bald man, facial stubble, casual clothes. Medium close-up of both at the bar counter. Keep the upper center/right relatively clean and uncluttered warm background. No speech bubbles, no text, no panel borders, no trophies.
